findings: Every bridge is at the nearest observed source boundary and crosses exactly one year. No approval relies on distant-year evidence.

Manual review of all raw definition diffs found only academic-year, cohort-year, annual source-table-year, annual Data Feedback Report-year changes and the exact perturbation notice. No fixed policy year, numeric identifier, population term, formula coefficient, or cohort duration was changed by normalization in an approved bridge.

Changes in titles were checked against full descriptions. Later SFA titles expand the already documented full-time first-time population; salary faculty/staff title wording has identical boundary definitions.

Transitive components bridge DFR to GR200 in 2005/2006 and GR200 to DRVGR in 2009/2010. GR200 internal reference-variable evolution remains in annual metadata. Groups lacking the second complete bridge remain partial.

This audit proves source-lane consolidation, not universal measurement invariance. Original within-lane SAT, aid, race/ethnicity and other definition changes remain and must remain visible in annual metadata.
The rolling-year comparison is safe only for this reviewed, source-hash-bound allowlist. It is not authorized as an automatic equivalence detector on changed or new sources.
